etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Middle English [Term?], from Old French conceder, from Latin concēdō (“give way, yield”), from con- (“wholly”) + cēdō (“to yield, give way, to go, grant”), from Proto-Indo-European *ked- (“to go, yield”).
senses: To yield or suffer; to surrender; to grant
To grant, as a right or privilege; to make concession of.
